title: Denial process records — §7922.540(b) names and the segregability record for W013113/W013137
summary:
Process request following the two full denials of the Flock network-audit requests. Asks for:

- Item 1: the names and titles or positions of each person responsible for the denial of W013113-072526, of W013137-072926, and of item 3 of W012665-050426, as set forth in Gov. Code § 7922.540(b), plus any record identifying who made each determination.
- Item 2: the Flock platform event log for 2026-07-20 forward, limited to report generation, audit export, network-audit, and search-audit query events, in native export format — the record type produced under W012570-041926.
- Item 3: routing, transmittal, assignment, and tasking records for the legal review the August 4 letter describes, between SMPD staff and the City Attorney's Office, with dates. Expressly not the content of any legal advice.
- Item 4: any record identifying which fields, portions, or categories were considered for release or redaction — review worksheet, redaction log, field-by-field notation, marked-up export, or exemption index. The record itself, not a narrative description.
- Item 5: a privilege index for anything withheld under items 3 or 4, by date, author, recipient, record type, and privilege asserted.

The context paragraph records that all three denial letters conclude without a signature block, name, or title, and quotes the August 4 letter's statement that "a legal review of your request was completed."

policy_promises.quote: The notification of denial shall set forth the names and titles or positions of each person responsible for the denial.
policy_promises.tests: Whether any denial notification identifies a responsible person, given that the letters are unsigned and the transmitting analyst is not the person the letters attribute the determination to.

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection ... after deletion of the portions that are exempt by law
policy_promises.tests: Whether any record documents field-level consideration of partial release before both requests were denied in full.

policy_promises.quote: records held by a contractor on behalf of an agency
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Flock event log shows any export or network-audit query during the response windows — i.e. whether the withheld records were ever retrieved.

prior_pra_refs.note: Denied in full 2026-07-29. Item 1 seeks the responsible-person names for that denial.
Narrowed refile of W013113, denied in full 2026-08-04. Its letter states a legal review was completed, which items 1 and 3 key on.
Item 3 denied by letter; third instance of an unsigned determination letter.
SMPD produced a Flock platform event log export under this request; item 2 seeks the same record type for a different event scope and period.

filed_because: Both network-audit denials rest on a rationale — the offense category and search time frame — that W013137 excluded by name, and neither letter offered a segregability analysis for the six fields actually requested. This asks for the records that would exist if partial release had been considered, and for the § 7922.540(b) identification the letters omit. A "no responsive records" answer to item 4 establishes that no field-level consideration was documented; an empty item 2 establishes that the withheld records were never retrieved.
notes:
Filed 2026-08-18; 10-day statutory determination due 2026-08-28. Answered 2026-08-28 2:37 PM, on the due date, by response letter dated 2026-08-26 signed by Kelly O'Keefe, Police Technical Services Administrator.

Disposition by item:
- Item 1: answered. The letter states the signatory "was identified in the message section of the GovQA portal but was inadvertently omitted from the response letter," and names Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst, as "the individual responsible for the response." One name is given for the response generally; the letter does not identify a responsible person separately for each of the three denials the item lists, and the record identifying who made each determination is not produced.
- Item 2: produced — event-logs.csv. The 2026-08-28 portal message states the City interprets item 2 "as the log provided" and asks for immediate notice if that reading is wrong.
- Item 3: denied under Gov. Code § 7927.705, Evid. Code § 954, and CCP § 2018.030. The item sought routing and transmittal records with dates and expressly disclaimed the content of any legal advice; the denial does not distinguish routing metadata from advice content.
- Item 4: "No responsive records." No review worksheet, redaction log, field-by-field notation, marked-up export, or exemption index exists from the responses to W013113 or W013137.
- Item 5: denied on the same privilege grounds.

Preceded by a 2026-08-24 clarification message asking the requester to attach the log referenced from the prior request; that message labels the quoted item 2 text as "item 3."

The letter's RE line cites "#W013261-081726" and its body cites "Reference No. W013262-081726"; the request's actual reference is W013262-081826. W013261-081826 is a separate request.
